name: Employee Attendance Detailed Report
query:
SELECT 
    `full_name` AS "Full Name",
    `date` AS "Date",
    `duration` AS "Duration",
    `present` AS "Present",
    `allowance` AS "Allowance",
    `project_name` AS "Project Name",
    `object` AS "Object",
    `tl_name` AS "TL"
FROM 
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master`
WHERE 
    (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR `date` >= %(from_date)s)
    AND 
    (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR `date` <= %(to_date)s)
